info.title: Open Software Factory contracts
info.description: The shared formats as named models. No operations: module APIs are added per module. Generated by `pnpm build` in contracts/ from typespec/. Do not edit.

id.description: Stable ID in the source system, prefixed with the source, for example "slack:U024BE7LH".

Actor.description: A person or trigger. RUNTIME-008: every run is attributed to one.

ActorKind.description: Who caused something: a person, or an automated trigger such as a cron rule or an alert.

harness.description: Harness adapter, declared under `providers.harness`, for example "claude-code".

model.description: A model ID or a routing alias of the inference gateway, for example "routes/triage".

repositories.description: Repositories the agent operates on, as clone URLs or "<owner>/<name>".

run.description: Job to run. Required with `cron`; without it an event starts the workflow.

Automation.description:
Starts the workflow, or the named job, on an event (`on`) or a schedule (`cron`). Exactly one of the two; a
schedule names its job. One model rather than a union, so every generated client reads it without guessing.

suite.description: Path to the Harbor task suite.

schedule.description: Five-field cron expression in UTC. Without it the suite runs on request.

BundlePath.description: A path inside the bundle: relative, forward slashes, no "..".

CommitHash.description: A Git commit hash, abbreviated (7+) or full. The factory version is the commit of the factory definition.

producer.description: The tool that wrote the bundle, for example proof 1.2.0.

result.description: Passed only when every scenario passed.

EvidenceManifest.description:
`evidence.json` at the root of an evidence bundle: what was verified, against which scenario IDs, with which
artifacts and result (P10).

$schema.description: Editors may point at this schema. Ignored by every tool.

version.description: Version of this format. A new major version of the format gets a new value.

providers.description: Adapters per port with a version range, pinned in `factory.lock` by `factory plan`.

workflow.description: Stages in order. Each stage runs one agent; the agent defaults to the stage name.

automations.description: What starts work without a person asking.

FormatVersion.description: The version of a format inside its documents. Only 1 exists; a new major version of a format adds the next.

policy.description: Path to the Rego policy that decides or picks the approvers.

approvers.description: Approver groups. The policy may narrow them.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

decidedBy.description: The person who decided. Absent only when the gate expired.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

GateRequested.description: gatekeeper: a decision is needed before a stage starts.

policy.description: Path to the policy in the factory definition.

approvers.description: Approver groups picked by the policy.

summary.description: What the approver is asked to decide, shown in the channel.

Identifier.description: An identifier chosen by the producer. ULIDs are recommended; consumers treat it as opaque.

Name.description: A lowercase name: letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Agents, stages, adapters, sources.

source.description: The channel or system, for example "slack", "github", "sentry", "cron", "mcp".

url.description: Link back to the origin, for example the Slack thread. Absent for a schedule.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

PrClosed.description: forge adapters: a pull request was merged or closed without a merge.

merged.description: True when the pull request was merged, false when it was closed without a merge.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

PrOpened.description: forge adapters: the factory opened a pull request.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

PrReviewed.description: forge adapters: a person, an agent or a bot reviewed or commented on a pull request.

automated.description: True when an agent or a bot wrote the review, not a person.

Providers.description: The adapters a factory uses, per port (docs/architecture/internals.md). Keys are adapter names.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

RunRecord.description:
The attributes of one run: the OTel resource of every span of the run, and the attributes of its root
`invoke_agent` span. The run record travels as OTLP; this schema fixes the attribute names and types.
Realizes SCN-FACTORY-DATA-001 (record shape) and SCN-FACTORY-RUNTIME-008 (attribution).

osf.factory.version.description: Commit of the factory definition the run used.

osf.source.description: Where the run was started from, for example "slack", "github", "cli".

RunResource.description: Set at launch through OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, so it is on every span of the run.

osf.cost.usd.description: Cost of all model calls of the run, from the inference gateway.

osf.transcript.uri.description: Full transcript, stored when the run ends.

osf.artifact.uris.description: Artifacts of the run: reports, screenshots, videos.

osf.agent_trace.uri.description: Agent Trace record with line attribution of the run's changes.

RunSpan.description: Attributes of the root span of the run. GenAI names where a convention exists.

cpu.description: CPU cores. The smallest unit is 0.001 (one millicore).

egress.description: Hostnames the sandbox may reach. Everything else is blocked.

artifacts.description: Paths of the artifacts in this bundle that prove the scenario.

ScenarioId.description: A scenario ID as checked by SPEC, for example SCN-PROOF-004.

value.description: A number for NUMERIC, 0 or 1 for BOOLEAN, a string for CATEGORICAL.

traceId.description: Trace of the run (the OTel trace ID).

observationId.description: Span the score is about, when it is not the whole run.

source.description: API for scorers, ANNOTATION for scores a person reviews.

Score.description:
The result of one scorer on one run. The fields are a subset of Langfuse's create-score request
(POST /api/public/scores), so a score can be sent to Langfuse as is. Factory fields live in `metadata`.

osf.judge.model.description: Judge model of an LLM scorer.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

ScoreRecorded.description: scorekit: a scorer scored a run.

judge.description: Path to the Markdown judge prompt.

sample.description: Share of runs to score, 0 to 1. Default 1.

SecretReference.description: A reference to a secret, resolved at the egress proxy, never in the sandbox: "ref:<provider>/<name>".

agent.description: Agent that runs the stage. Defaults to the agent with the stage's name.

gate.description: The stage waits for a decision before it starts.

evidence.description: Whether the stage must produce an evidence bundle.

TraceId.description: An OpenTelemetry trace ID: 32 lowercase hex characters.

VersionRange.description: A semver range of an adapter, for example "^2".

requester.description: The person or trigger that asked for the work.

dedupeKey.description: Requests with the same key become one work item, for example "github:acme/web#42".

surface.description: Product surface the work is about, for example "checkout".

links.description: Related material: an error report, a change, a document.

WorkItem.description: One unit of requested work: the `data` of a `work.received@v1` CloudEvent.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

WorkReceived.description: intake: a work item was accepted.
